sources.title: GitHub - google-research/byt5
sources.snippet: ByT5 is a tokenizer-free extension of the mT5 model. Instead of using a subword vocabulary like most other pretrained language models (BERT, XLM-R, T5, GPT-3), our ByT5 model operates directly on UTF-8 bytes, removing the need for any text preprocessing. sources.snippet: ByT5 is tokenizer-free version of the T5 model designed to works directly on raw UTF-8 bytes. This means it can process any language, more robust to noise like typos, and simpler to use because it doesn't require a preprocessing pipeline. You can find all the original ByT5 checkpoints under the Google organization.

sources.title: Will Wade
sources.snippet: Fine-tuning a Language Model: We took a small but powerful AI model (called t5-small) and taught it to correct noisy sentences. Think of this as perfecting a secret family recipe. Developing Algorithmic Code: We also wrote specific computer code designed to fix spelling errors and add spaces where words were run together.
